steps.message: I want to ensure that when my AI assistant presents a plan to me, it automatically follows up with a clear instruction to execute that plan. This should help prevent the AI from simply continuing to elaborate on the plan instead of moving forward with action. Specifically, after the assistant displays the plan content, I want the system to immediately show a user-style message saying "Now go on and execute this plan." This creates a natural transition that signals the assistant to stop planning and start implementing the steps. The message should appear exactly once after each plan is shown, but only when the full conversation is being displayed (not in summary mode). I need this behavior to be consistent and automatic every time a plan is generated and presented to me.

def test_planning_step_to_messages():
    planning_step = PlanningStep(
        model_input_messages=[Message(role=MessageRole.USER, content="Hello")],
        model_output_message=ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.ASSISTANT, content="Plan"),
        plan="This is a plan.",
    )
    messages = planning_step.to_messages(summary_mode=False)
    assert len(messages) == 2
    for message in messages:
        assert isinstance(message, dict)
        assert "role" in message
        assert "content" in message
        assert isinstance(message["role"], MessageRole)
        assert message["role"] in (MessageRole.ASSISTANT, MessageRole.USER)
        assert isinstance(message["content"], list)
        assert len(message["content"]) == 1
        for content in message["content"]:
            assert isinstance(content, dict)
            assert "type" in content
            assert "text" in content
    assert messages[0]["role"] == MessageRole.ASSISTANT
    assert messages[0]["content"][0]["text"] == "This is a plan."
    assert messages[1]["role"] == MessageRole.USER
    assert messages[1]["content"][0]["text"] == "Now go on and execute this plan."

    # In summary mode, no messages should be returned
    assert planning_step.to_messages(summary_mode=True) == []
